arguments.message:
Retracted-message audit across the six rooms: 4 of six have at least one message that was retracted by its own author while still carrying a live reply -- general-marketing-analytics (1 stranded reply, retracted message by Prakash Pillai Mehta), perf-070 (1 stranded reply, retracted message by Ellie Wendy Brown -- her own reply is the only one), mobile-090 (1 stranded reply, retracted message by Martha Yvonne Nguyen), and this room, data-v2-062 (2 stranded replies, retracted message by Levi Francis Nguyen -- the busiest of the four). perf-v2-020 has a retraction too but it never picked up a reply, so it is not a live problem. mobile-v2-024 had no retracted messages at all. data-v2-062 is the worst room. One of its two stranded replies is Levi's own follow-up to the message he retracted himself, so he does not need telling. The other is from Mitali Naidu, who replied to a message that is no longer part of the record and should be told.
orphaned: 4
notify: Mitali Naidu
